newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Singapore rubber market was closed on Wednesday due to a national holiday. The market will reopen on Thursday.
The rubber market finished weakly on Tuesday with most players leaving early ahead of the holiday. The sharp fall in the Tokyo rubber market had little impact in the local market, dealers said.
The January/March RSS3 rubber contract ended on Tuesday at 117.00 U.S. cents a kg from 119.25 cents. October/December TSR20 closed two U.S. cents down at 110.75 cents a kg.
